summary: A revision of the File Transfer Protocol from RFC 172. It adds two new file transfer requests, new error codes and editorial clarifications, then restates the protocol. FTP is a user-level protocol for moving files between ARPANET hosts. It was updated by several RFCs and replaced by RFC 354.

eli5.summary: The rules for copying files from one computer to another across the network, rewritten with a few extra commands and error messages.
